answer: Histories are stored in fable, checked in nadir, and ocean shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 10 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 3941 identities would post 1262 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
